{{Top|leg}}
'''Habensa''' was a term in the [[Argazdan (language)|Argazdan]]. During the period of the [[Old Sith Wars]] and the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]], it translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] as 'one who sculpts or shapes'. Habensa was used to describe the mysterious [[Yuuzhan Vong|alien]] [[Unidentified female Yuuzhan Vong Shaper|artisan shaper]] who created the [[Slave Pits of Lorrd]] circa [[3670 BBY]], towards the end of the [[Argazdan Redoubt]].

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], however, the term had become the analogy for the Basic term [[Architect/Legends|architect]]. Around that time, the historian Dr. [[Heilan Rotham]] found inscriptions of the word on nearby [[Deejo tablet]]s.<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}</ref>
